exact_statement: Let g be any Boolean function on a finite uniform cube, m=ghat(empty)^2. Let D be a nonnegative subprobability with D(empty)=m and finite c=CE(P_g,D). Supply normalized S,Q with S>=D, Q(empty)>=m, and Q(T)>=gamma D(T) for every nonempty T, 0<gamma<=1. For every finite adaptive tree querying fresh physical coordinates per path, at any chosen subset of stopping leaves reset to the direct marginal of S with ONE final vacuum calibration to the actual child mean-square, using the explicit empty point law for constant children; all other leaves retain the full inherited direct marginal of Q. Expected spectral erasure debits plus all complete terminal cross entropies are at most c+(1-m^2)log2(1/gamma). More sharply the excess is at most log2(1/gamma) times the sum over retained leaves of physical reach times [(1-m)+m Var(g_leaf)]. An arbitrary continuation below a fresh frontier leaf, with further calibrations of the CURRENT inherited reference, is paid by the complete-reference chain and nonpositive calibration costs; retained old frontier leaves admit no-reset continuation. This supplies no influence-priced reference, no likelihood floor for arbitrary incoming profiles, and no repeated return to the ORIGINAL source marginal after intervening calibrations. Entropy units bits.

exact_statement: Let g be any Boolean function on a finite uniform cube, m=ghat(empty)^2. Supply a nonnegative subprobability D with D(empty)=m, total mass<=1 and finite c=CE(P_g,D), and normalized S,Q with S>=D, Q(empty)>=m, Q(T)>=gamma D(T) for every nonempty T, 0<gamma<=1. In ANY finite adaptive physical query tree, choose ANY nodes, including internal nodes, to reset to Cal(M_A S,P_node(empty)), where M_A deletes exactly the queried frequency coordinates on that path and Cal sets the vacuum mass while preserving the conditional nonempty distribution; at constant nodes use the explicit vacuum point law. At all other nodes inherit the CURRENT complete reference by the actual spectral marginal, beginning with Q at the root. Every complementary branch and old debit remains. Then the expected sum of all spectral erasures and all complete final terminal cross entropies is <=c+(1-m^2)log2(1/gamma). After the FIRST reset on each path, every further return to the SAME ORIGINAL S marginal followed by vacuum calibration is EXACTLY calibration of the current inherited reference, so its signed CE cost is -D_Ber(P_node(empty)||Q_inherited(empty))<=0. Specifically Cal(M Cal(P,z),w)=Cal(M P,w) on the finite-CE actual Boolean-path domain. This adds ZERO cost, reset-count factor or depth factor to the original A096 first-frontier theorem. Reference-only atoms and normalizers are retained. It excludes an uncalibrated raw return, a changed conditional nonempty distribution, a different source S, or an influence-priced universal supplier. Entropy units bits; full FEI remains OPEN.
